info.title: Brillianda API
info.description: Multi-tenant school registry API. The school is resolved from the request host; call it through the frontend's /api rewrite. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json); see docs/api-conventions.md.

logoUrl.description: Relative to the school's own address, e.g. /api/v1/school/logo?v=…; null without a logo

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Switch on this.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

errors.description: validation_failed only: one entry per field.

reason.description: verification_failed: invalid | expired | too_many_attempts. subdomain_unavailable: taken | reserved | invalid.

nextStep.description: signup_incomplete only: the step to do first.

existingAccount.description: The verified email already has a Brillianda account; step 4 needs its password

codeSentTo.description: Masked email the last code went to

allOf.description: When the school's year starts, e.g. { month: 9, year: 2026 }. Omitted: September of the current session

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response from the widget

handoverUrl.description: Open within 60 seconds; the school's address exchanges it for a session

existingPassword.description: Only when the draft says existingAccount: the password of that Brillianda account

existingAccount.description: true: just accept. false: also send fullName and password

joinedAt.description: When they gained access to this school (ISO 8601)

confirmed.description: false until someone saves the calendar; the dates are only suggestions until then

classes.description: Class arms in use, e.g. JSS 1 Gold

admins.description: Everyone with access, the owner included

who.description: The person's name, or "Someone" if their account is gone

levelsOffered.description: From signup, lowercase: nursery, primary, secondary

key.description: Ladder place ("jss1"), or null for a class the school added

armsByLevel.description: For each level (same order), the arms it has, as indexes into `arms`

NewClassArm.description: { armNameId } for an existing arm name, or { name, code } for a new one

key.description: An arm name's id, or any new key such as "new-1"

levels.description: Every class in use (not archived), each with the keys of the arms it should have

bands.description: The NERDC bands the school's classes fall in

catalogueName.description: The catalogue's name when the school renamed it, else null

changes.description: Changes to this student, newest first

total.description: How many match, before the limit

people.description: Everyone who appears in the history, for the filter

student.description: The filtered student, when studentId is given

armId.description: Importing from a class page: every row goes to this class

ImportRawRow.description: Cells by column id (firstName, lastName, gender, className, …), as mapped in the browser

armId.description: Importing from a class page: every row goes to this class

update.description: Indexes of duplicate rows to update instead of skip

post.summary: Step 1: school details. Starts a signup, or updates the one in progress
Step 2: the owner's account. Sends a 6-digit code to the email
